verdict.rationale: cubic documents mechanisms aimed at noise reduction — learning from replies/thumbs-up-down to calibrate 'useful vs noise' (cubic-docs-10), configurable ignore patterns and custom org-specific rules via cubic.yaml (cubic-docs-9, cubic-docs-11), and hiding test files from diffs (cubic-docs-14) — plus a positive community mention of well-calibrated, technical feedback (cubic-comm-1). However, there is no explicit documentation of severity labels on comments or deduplication of comments across a PR, and one community voice raises doubts about YAML-rule reliability (cubic-comm-2). Missing for 10: explicit severity/priority labeling of findings, explicit deduplication logic for repeated/similar comments, and independent quantitative false-positive-rate evidence.
